answer: Send hidden mirror probes. Each epoch the ledger quietly gives the same random prompt to pairs of identities picked by lot, inside their normal river of work. Independent agents built by different operators answer in different words, but a farm running one model with one prompt returns near-identical text. Pairs whose answers match far above chance across 20 probes are merged into one reward and one vote, so the payout per fake falls to its nadir and splitting a box into many keys earns nothing extra.
